label: Ok
name: ok
hint: True when the call did what it was meant to, including a press that was answered with a private note.

toggle_field.label: Ok
toggle_field.name: ok
toggle_field.hint: True when the call did what it was meant to, including a press that was answered with a private note.

label: Error
name: error
hint: What went wrong, when something did. Empty otherwise.

label: Warnings
name: warnings
hint: Things that did not stop the call: a ticket that could not be sent, a message that could not be redrawn, a table write that failed.

label: Skipped
name: skipped
hint: Non-empty when nothing happened and that was right: not a person typing / no keyword / only the host can do that / the game is not running / already in / the same press made twice / another press is starting this game / game not available.

label: Mode
name: mode
hint: What the call was: setup (the word was typed), panel (the word brought the organizer's controls back), ticket (the word sent a player their ticket again; or a press of Show my card / Hide my card), set, pick, join, start, cancel, next, review, resume, end, mark (a number tapped, on a ticket in a private message or on the organizer's card in their note), or click when the press could not be read.

label: Testing
name: testing
hint: True for a test game or a press on one: nothing was written to the data table.

toggle_field.label: Testing
toggle_field.name: testing
toggle_field.hint: True for a test game or a press on one: nothing was written to the data table.

label: Preview
name: preview
hint: True when nothing was posted (skip_post = yes): the cards are in preview_json.

toggle_field.label: Preview
toggle_field.name: preview
toggle_field.hint: True when nothing was posted (skip_post = yes): the cards are in preview_json.

label: Game ID
name: game_id
hint: The game's id: tb_<channel>_<message ts>. Also the id of every row of the game.

label: Status
name: status
hint: The game's status after the call: lobby, starting, running, paused, done or cancelled.

label: Controls
name: controls
hint: What became of the organizer's private note on this press: "in place" (replaced through response_url), "new note" (a new private note was sent: response_url is not mapped, or it was turned down, see warnings), "new note without buttons" (Slack turned the buttons down, see warnings), "not delivered" (neither worked) or empty (nothing was said to the organizer, as for a Next number without response_url).

label: Channel
name: channel
hint: The channel of the call.

label: User ID
name: user_id
hint: Whoever typed the word or pressed the control.

label: User name
name: user_name
hint: Their name, when the call looked it up.

label: Message ts
name: message_ts
hint: [set] ts of the lobby. [start] ts of the board.

label: Players
name: players
hint: [set, pick, join, start] How many players the game has.

label: Called
name: called
hint: How many numbers have been called.

label: Number
name: number
hint: [next] The number just called. 0 when no number was called.

label: Marked
name: marked
hint: [mark] The number the player just marked. 0 when the press marked nothing (not called yet, already marked).

label: Prize
name: prize
hint: [mark] The prize or prizes this press won, as Early Five, Top Line ... Empty when none.

label: Finished
name: finished
hint: True when the call ended the game: Full House, the 90th number, or End game.

toggle_field.label: Finished
toggle_field.name: finished
toggle_field.hint: True when the call ended the game: Full House, the 90th number, or End game.

label: Dm sent
name: dm_sent
hint: [start] How many players were sent their ticket.

label: Dm failed
name: dm_failed
hint: [start] Names of players whose ticket could not be sent, or was not reached in time. They get theirs by typing the word again (the organizer, with My ticket).

label: Rows written
name: rows_written
hint: Table rows written or updated by this call. 0 for a test game.

label: Preview json
name: preview_json
hint: [skip_post] JSON of every card, each a list of blocks: setup, lobby, organizer_lobby, organizer_pick, board, organizer_running, organizer_card, review, organizer_paused, ticket, board_over.
